posts.title: d20 Power Shifts
posts.description: As factions butt heads in ongoing campaigns, it can be tempting to treat their conflicts as something that never resolves, or that resolves like a sliding scale, where each major event affecting them ticks towards one side winning out and away from another side. posts.title: d20 Fishing Table
posts.description: Roll a d20, rounding down for repeats if the catch is no longer available. 1. Nothing bites 2. Trout 3. Mackerel 4. Carp 5. Old branch 6. Salmon 7. Old boot 8. Giant Catfish. Take 1d6 damage or get pulled into the water. If you hold strong, take another 1d6 damage to drag it onto the bank. 9. Doppelschwimmer.
